name: Facet
text: Ship a live contrast checker that runs before any submission. It flags low-contrast text or lines the moment you hit “submit,” forcing the interface to stay readable. This trades a tiny extra click for bulletproof clarity—no more squinting at graphs or missing data points because colors blended into the background. Users see the problem immediately, fix it on the spot, and the dashboard stays lively and enjoyable without manual review.

name: Pane
text: The real risk is training users to ignore the contrast problem—once they see it flagged, they’ll treat it as someone else’s job to fix. A better alternative is to block submissions entirely until contrast meets a strict threshold, not just warn. Settle it by testing: measure how often users override the block versus how often they adjust contrast when warned.
